scenes.audio: Upbeat, light electronic background music starts. A soft, high-pitched notification ping or 'ding' sound effects occurs simultaneously with the visual highlighting of the specific file.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static screenshot of a software download page on a web browser. The background is light gray with a list of downloadable file names in blue text, file hashes in gray, and file sizes. A white circular mask with a drop shadow highlights the middle section of the list, specifically targeting the 'LosslessCut-mac-arm64.dmg' file. The overall lighting is even and digital, with a cool-toned color palette dominated by blues, grays, and whites.

scenes.audio: The upbeat electronic background music continues at the same tempo and volume. A second soft 'ding' sound effect plays to coincide with the movement and placement of the circular highlight mask.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The same static web browser interface from Scene 1 is shown. The white circular mask shifts downward to highlight a different section of the list, specifically focusing on the 'LosslessCut-mac-x64.dmg' file. The rest of the screen is slightly darkened to emphasize the highlighted circular area. The color grading remains consistent with the previous scene.
